content: Azure DDoS Protection peacetime telemetry is now in public preview. Customers can now see the traffic reaching their protected public IP addresses during normal operation, not only while a DDoS mitigation is active. Previously, outside an active mitigation, a protected public IP address showed only its mitigation-trigger metrics. With peacetime telemetry, the existing incoming DDoS traffic metrics (total, TCP, SYN, UDP and other traffic) show data during normal operation. Customers can use this data to understand normal traffic patterns, compare everyday traffic with mitigation triggers, create Azure Monitor metric alerts with workload-specific thresholds, and test dashboards and alerts without simulating an attack. Peacetime telemetry works automatically for public IP addresses protected by DDoS Network Protection or DDoS IP Protection, with no registration and no new metric names. Viewing the metrics doesn't require Log Analytics or diagnostic settings, and protection and mitigation behavior don't change. There's no additional cost beyond existing DDoS Protection pricing; standard Azure Monitor charges apply to alert rules. During the preview, peacetime telemetry is available in the Azure public cloud. Learn more: Read about peacetime telemetry availability Set up traffic-condition alerts during peacetime
